title: API key does not grant play access to the whole public set

detail: Retry sweep, 3 rounds over the 4 development-pile games: g50t-5849a774 OK/400/400; ar25, sk48, tn36 400 every time. Combined with the earlier successful RESET, g50t succeeded 2 of 4 attempts while the other three succeeded 0 of 6. So three games look genuinely unavailable to this key, and a second effect refuses repeat RESETs on g50t -- most likely a live session (guid 9a0c05b1) already open, or a start-rate limit. The API reports both conditions with the same message, 'game <id> not found'.
non_destructive_scope_check: No scope endpoint exists: /api/account, /api/me, /api/key and /api/games/available all 404; /api/user 401s (exists, but X-API-Key is not its auth); ?playable=true is ignored and returns all 25. The playable set cannot be determined without attempting a RESET, which burns the game.
